contract: guide-contract cases v3 - the editor half of session, request and locate (platform SPEC-lesson-layers section 3, stage A1). The same file, byte for byte, in kishufiya, kishufonet and the platform.

reasons.offscreen: the target is not on the screen (also a block of the code outside the code area's view)
reasons.on-the-way: only the way to it is on screen (a closed category, another sprite's tile); `via` says which
reasons.unsupported:<what>: this editor has no such thing
reasons.scrolling: a found target went out of view while the editor itself scrolls to it
reasons.other: any other word is the editor's own, finer reason for a target that is not here (with `by`, the thing covering it); the page reads an unknown reason as offscreen

steps.hear: heard(state, msg) -> expect {heard, orders, pass} and, when given, what it says back (say), the session and the requests of the places held after it
steps.look: looked(state, request, see, at, after) -> expect {say, soft}
steps.stamp: inSession(answer, asking(to), more) -> expect the answer
steps.opens: opens(msg) -> expect whether the editor answers it before it is up
steps.alive: Boolean(locateOf(state, request)) -> expect (a guide-scroll {id: request} is done only for a place alive)
steps.reason: reasonSaid(word, asking(to)) -> expect the word said in guide-missing

cases.name: opening: engine-hello before anything was heard is answered with session 0, and nothing changes
opening: answered with the highest session heard; the page starts at that + 1, which begins a session
opening: engine-hello is the one message answered from the moment the editor page loads, before it is up
save: project-saved that answers a save of a session carries the session and the request
opening: answered whatever the hello carries, also a number the editor would drop (a clock that moved back)
after a guide: guide-scroll, guide-frame, guide-show, guide-key and guide-typed are messages of the session
old engine: a message with no session is handled as ever, voids nothing, and its answers are untouched
guide: a field this editor does not know (pointer, keepOff of a menu) is ignored: the message is handled as without it
session: the first one heard begins from nothing (the mark, the freeze, the pick and the places go)
session: a higher one begins from nothing, and the places of the one before are gone
session: a message of a lower number than the highest heard is stale and dropped, whatever it is
session: a message with no session after a session voids nothing
locate: with no session it is ignored (a place is asked only in a session)
locate: several at once; the same request again replaces; one with no point or no request is not kept
locate-clear: with a request that place ends, with no request all of them
located: found true, said once and on every change of where it is
located: found false offscreen, once, after the wait; nothing before it
located: a found one that is lost is said at once
located: no game open and a target this editor has none of are said at once
located: only the way is on screen - found false, on-the-way, via set, no rect, no soft mark
located: in a scrolling box - told with its scroller, no soft mark while out of view, guide-scroll by its request
located: the soft mark only with highlight
located: drop is said when the editor knows it
located: a target on its way by itself is not counted missing; lost after found it is said at once
located: said again when the reason changes; an editor's own reason and `by` pass as they are
id === request: every answer in a session carries the request as its id
reason: in a session "not on the screen" is offscreen in both editors
